)

Logic 2:
(Logic 2.1: OSCN. Scheduled Time <> RSP. “Scheduled Time”
AND
Logic 2.2: OSCN. Scan Date = RSP.“Date Response Determined”
)

OR

(Logic 2.3: OSCN. Scheduled Time <> ORAJ. Scheduled Time
AND
Logic 2.4: OSCN. Scan Date = ORAJ.Date of Assessment (Scan/Image/Physical Exam)
)

Logic 3:
Logic 3.1: LSN.Date of Initial Identification = LSN.Date of Lesion Evaluation time
AND
Logic 3.2: LSN.“Scheduled time” <> OSCN. “Scheduled”
AND 
Logic 3.3: LSN.Date of Initial Identification = OSCN.Scan Date

OEFU.Date of Assessment >= [ONCOLOGIC RESPONSE FORM].DATE RESPONSE DETERMINED/ ORAJ. Date of Assessment (Scan/Image/Physica Exam))

AND

OEDRA.Date of Assessment >= [ONCOLOGIC RESPONSE FORM].DATE RESPONSE DETERMINED/ ORAJ. Date of Assessment (Scan/Image/Physica Exam) )
}

1. row for each Treatment Phase Order, PMS Form, Status for Next Trial Segment

25-     'Expected Timeframe' will be calculated using the items 'Minimal start timepoint', 'Start week', 'Stop week', 'Frequency', 'Lower window of days', 'Upper window of days'.
Steps to calculate the 'Expected Timeframe': 
A.      Calculate different timepoints by doing the following mathematical operation: 
Timepoint 1: Minimal start timepoint + Start week 
Timepoint 2: Minimal start timepoint + Start week + 1*Frequency 
Timepoint 3: Minimal start timepoint + Start week + 2*Frequency 
Timepoint N: Minimal start timepoint + Start week + (N-1)*Frequency 
B.      Timepoints calculated on step A should be: Minimal start timepoint + Start week <= Timepoint N <= Minimal start timepoint + Stop week
C.      Expected Timeframe = From Timepoint N - 'Lower window of days' to Timepoint N + 'Upper window of days' 
Example: 
A.      Minimal start timepoint = 01-Jan-2020 
B.      Start week = 6 
C.      Stop week = 30 
D.      Frequency = 6 
E.      Lower window of days = 7 
F.      Upper window of days = 7 
Timepoint 1 = 01-Jan-2020 + 6 weeks = 12-Feb-2020 
Expected Timeframe 1 = From 05-Feb-2020 to 19-Feb-2020 
Timepoint 2 = 01-Jan-2020 + 6 weeks + 6 weeks = 25-Mar-2020 
Expected Timeframe 2 = From 18-Mar-2020 to 01-Apr-2020 
Timepoint 3 = 01-Jan-2020 + 6 weeks + 12 weeks = 06-May-2020 
Expected Timeframe 3 = From 29-Apr-2020 to 13-May-2020

Enter ‘DOV’ if study wants to use the Minimal start timepoint as DOV of visit from study_phase_supp or ‘SR’ if minimal start point for first treatment phase should be set as Date of assessment from SR eCRF. Simply enter 'NA' for Scenario 1.
12.      Lesion Evaluation Form – Required for Scenario 1,2. Enter LSNHM/LSNEV/LSRIR/LSNPC/LSNPI/LSNRN/LSNIR/LSNBC/LOEL/LSNEI 
13.      Trial Segment Reference – Required for Scenario 1. Enter the trial segment reference value from PMS1/PMST according to each treatment phase. For Scenario 2, simply enter as 'NA'
14.      PMS1A Trial Segment Reference – Required for Scenario 1,2. Enter the trial segment reference value from PMS1A according to each treatment phase. If your study does not use PMS1A then simply enter as 'NA'
15. Group for Method – Optional for Scenario 1,2. This column and Method of Assessment should be used together. Used to group the different Methods of Assessment allowed per protocol requirements. If the same Group is used across more than one method (e.g., CT Scan or MRI), the report will not produce output if any of those methods are already entered in the eCRF, please note that when using the same “Group for Method” the following parameters need to be the same for such group: “Lower window of days”, “Upper window of days”, “Frequency”, “Start week”, “Stop week”, “Oncologic Treatment”, “Oncologic Radiation” and “Oncologic Surgery”. If different Groups are used across more than one method (e.g., CT Scan and MRI), the report will not produce output if both methods are already entered in the eCRF, meaning that, if one is entered and the other is NOT entered, the report will show output for the missing one. If there is no need to consider the Method of Assessment for the study, simply type in NA.
16. Method of Assessment – Optional for Scenario 1,2. Type in the Method of Assessment (e.g, CT Scan) that needs to be checked during each lesion evaluation. If there is no need to consider the Method of Assessment for the study, simple type in NA.  
17.      Lower window of days – Required for Scenario 1,2. For Scenario 1 enter the amount of days when the last lesion evaluation should occur before the discontinuation of each treatment phase e.g., 'scan is required within 4 weeks prior to discontinuation' then enter 28. For Scenario 2 enter the amount of days corresponding to the window applicable for each imaging timepoint e.g., 'imaging scans will occur every 6 weeks +/- 7', then enter 7.
18.      Upper window of days – Optional for Scenario 1. For Scenario 1 enter the amount of days when the last lesion evaluation should occur post discontinuation of each treatment phase e.g., 'scan is required within +/- 4 weeks from discontinuation' then enter 28, if your study does not use this window then simply enter as 'NA'. Required for Scenario 2, enter the amount of days corresponding to the window applicable for each imaging timepoint e.g., 'imaging scans will occur every 3 weeks +/- 7', then enter 7.
19.      Frequency – Required for Scenario 2. Enter the number of weeks when each lesion should be assessed from start week e.g., 'The imaging assessment should be performed at Week 6 (42 ± 7 days), Week 12 (84 ± 7 days) and Week 18 (126 ± 7 days) from the date of randomization', then enter 6. If the frequency changes during the same treatment phase a new row is expected with a new frequency e.g., 'Subsequent tumor imaging should be performed every 9 weeks (63 days ±7 days) until week 45', then enter 9. The value should always be in weeks. For Scenario 1 simply enter as 'NA'
20.      Start week – Required for Scenario 2. Enter the week when the first lesion evaluation should occur from first visit applicable to each frequency e.g., 'The imaging assessment should be performed at Week 6 (42 ± 7 days), Week 12 (84 ± 7 days) and Week 18 (126 ± 7 days) from the date of randomization.', then enter 6. If the frequency changes during the same treatment phase then a new row is expected with a new start week e.g., 'Subsequent tumor imaging should be performed every 9 weeks (63 days ±7 days) until week 45' then enter 27 (last stop week + new frequency 18+9 = 27) as the new start week. The value should always be in weeks. For Scenario 1 simply enter as 'NA'.
21.      Stop week – Optional for Scenario 2. Enter the stop week when the last lesion evaluation should occur applicable to each frequency e.g., 'The imaging assessment should be performed at Week 6 (42 ± 7 days), Week 12 (84 ± 7 days) and Week 18 (126 ± 7 days) from the date of randomization.', then enter 18. If the frequency changes during the same treatment phase then a new row is expected with a new stop week e.g., 'Subsequent tumor imaging should be performed every 9 weeks (63 days ±7 days) until week 45' then enter 45 as the new stop week. Do NOT overlap start and stop week between multiple rows. If there is no 'stop week' simply enter as 'NA' and the report will output missing lesion evaluations until PMS1A/OEDRA is completed e.g., 'The first on study imaging assessment should be performed at 12 weeks (84 days ±7 days) after the restart of treatment. Subsequent tumor imaging should be performed every 12 weeks (84 days ±7 days) or more frequently if clinically indicated' then enter 'NA' as the stop week. The value should always be in weeks. For Scenario 1 simply enter as 'NA'
22.     Oncologic Treatment – Optional for Scenario 2, enter ODBF/ODBHF/ODBNF/ODBCF if as soon as a new therapy starts in the ODBX form lesion evaluations are NO longer required. Enter 'NA' when per protocol lesion evaluations can be performed beyond the start of a new anti-cancer therapy. For Scenario 1 simply enter as 'NA'
23.     Oncologic Radiation – Optional for Scenario 2, enter ORAD2 if as soon as a new therapy starts in the ORAD2 form lesion evaluations are NO longer required. Enter 'NA' when per protocol lesion evaluations can be performed beyond the start of a new anti-cancer therapy. For Scenario 1 simply enter as 'NA'
24.     Oncologic Surgery – Optional for Scenario 2, enter OSOF/OSOFL if as soon as a new therapy starts in the OSOFX form lesion evaluations are NO longer required. Enter 'NA' when per protocol lesion evaluations can be performed beyond the start of a new anti-cancer therapy. For Scenario 1 simply enter as 'NA'
25.     Scenario – Required, enter 1,2. If one scenario is not applicable for your study then there is no need to provide a row in the supporting document for that scenario.
